name: EveryInfra
description: Social data & search infrastructure for the AI era. One universal endpoint (`/api/v1/social`) covers 90 platforms / 409 capabilities across three domains — social (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, YouTube, Threads…), reviews (Google Maps, Yelp, Trustpilot, App Store…), e-commerce (Amazon, AliExpress, Walmart, eBay…) and web search. General-purpose chat is retired; source-bound EveryData cleanup is documented separately. One shared prepaid balance, denominated in USD. Data/search is priced per platform tier — USD 0.56/1K (Benchmark, 106 capabilities) / USD 1.39/1K (Standard, 273 capabilities) / USD 2.78/1K (Deep, 4 capabilities) / USD 5.56/1K (Hard-target, 26 capabilities); One call, one charge. Most actions deliver the row count you ask for in a single call (see `max_limit` in the catalog); page-based actions (`page_size` in the catalog) return one page per call, and each further page is one call. Monthly top-up discount based on top-ups credited in the current calendar month (Beijing time), at face value: 10% off from USD 500; 20% off from USD 1,000; 30% off from USD 2,000 — applies from the next call once reached and resets on the 1st; credit codes and bonuses do not count. Authenticate with a Bearer API key — sign up free at https://api.everyinfra.com; trial credits available on request. Prefer MCP? `POST /mcp` exposes 7 currently discoverable tools (everyinfra_list_capabilities, everyinfra_call_api, everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_solve_captcha, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_data_cleanup_read, everyinfra_data_cleanup_action) — see https://api.everyinfra.com/llms.txt for details.
